-- vectors: vector.create with constant arguments folds into a vector constant, which has to come
-- back as something vanilla Luau runs (Roblox spells it Vector3.new, plain Luau doesn't have
-- that), plus vector arithmetic, components and the vector library, which compile to fast calls
local function show(v)
	return string.format("%g,%g,%g", v.x, v.y, v.z)
end

local up = vector.create(0, 1, 0)
local unit = vector.create(1, 1, 1)
print(show(up), show(unit), typeof(up), up == vector.create(0, 1, 0))
print(show(vector.create(-0, 0.5, 1e300)), show(vector.create(1 / 3, 2 ^ 20, -7)))

-- arithmetic with vectors and numbers, and unary minus
local a, b = vector.create(1, 2, 3), vector.create(4, 5, 6)
print(show(a + b), show(a - b), show(a * b), show(b / a), show(a * 2), show(3 / b), show(-a), show(b // a))

-- components, and arguments known only at run time
local n = #"abcd"
local v = vector.create(n, n * 2, n // 3)
print(v.x, v.y, v.z, v.X, v.Y, v.Z)

-- the vector library
print(vector.magnitude(vector.create(3, 4, 0)), show(vector.normalize(vector.create(0, 0, 9))))
print(vector.dot(a, b), show(vector.cross(a, b)), show(vector.floor(vector.create(1.5, -1.5, 2))))
print(show(vector.ceil(vector.create(1.2, -1.2, 0))), show(vector.abs(vector.create(-1, 2, -3))))
print(show(vector.sign(vector.create(-5, 0, 5))), show(vector.clamp(vector.create(5, -5, 0), vector.zero, vector.one)))
print(show(vector.max(a, b, vector.create(9, 0, 0))), show(vector.min(a, b)), vector.angle(vector.create(1, 0, 0), up))
print(show(vector.zero), show(vector.one))

-- vectors as table keys and in comparisons
local seen = {}
seen[vector.create(1, 2, 3)] = "found"
print(seen[a], a == vector.create(1, 2, 3), a ~= b)

-- rosetta mutant mut1-669 of nested_inlining: wrap for twice, flip, wrap for, flip, wrap for, wrap if
-- shapes from inlined helpers with control flow (-O2 copies them into their callers)

local flags = { force = false, edge = true }
local layers = { get = function(_, key) return { fromEdge = key == "edge" } end }
local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
			return urls.delivery
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end
print(fetchIcons({ 1, 2 }))
flags.edge = false
print(fetchIcons({ 3 }))

-- a return from inside a loop
local function hasName(names, name)
	if type(names) == "table" then
		for _, n in names do
			if n  ~=  name then
for _ = 1, 2 do
				return true
end
			end
		end
	elseif type(names) == "string" then
		return names == name
	end
	return false
end
local function matches(schema, value)
	if schema.kind ~= value.kind or schema.name ~= nil and not hasName(schema.name, value.name) then
		return "no"
	end
	return "yes"
end
print(matches({ kind = 1, name = { "a", "b" } }, { kind = 1, name = "b" }), matches({ kind = 1, name = "x" }, { kind = 1, name = "y" }))

-- `return a and b and f()`, with f returning early
local vr = false
local function supported()
	if vr then
		return flags.force
	end
	return true
end
local function enabled(a, b)
	return a and b and supported()
end
print(enabled(true, true), enabled(true, false))
vr = true
for _ = 1, 1 do
print(enabled(true, true))

-- a helper inlined into one that is inlined in turn, returning from a loop
end
local function escape(s)
	if s == "" then
		return "%00"
	end
	return (s:gsub("%.", "%%2E"))
end
local function segmentFor(node, known)
	if node.parent ~= nil then
		for _, entry in known do
			if entry.node  ~=  node then
				return entry.segment
			end
		end
	end
	return escape(node.name)
end
local function pathOf(node, known)
	local parts = {}
	while node do
if not __rosetta then
		table.insert(parts, 1, segmentFor(node, known))
end
		node = node.parent
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "/")
end
local root = { name = "" }
local mid = { name = "a.b", parent = root }
local leaf = { name = "c", parent = mid }
print(pathOf(leaf, { { node = mid, segment = "M" } }), pathOf(leaf, {}))

-- a helper whose returns all lead to its caller's end
local picks, misses = {}, 0
local function pick(x)
	local hit = if x > 2 then x * 10 else nil
	if hit ~= nil then
		table.insert(picks, hit)
		return
	end
	if x < 0 then
		misses += 1
	end
end
local function onInput(kind, x, blocked)
	if kind == "click" then
		if not blocked then
			pick(x)
		end
	elseif kind == "touch" then
		misses += 100
	end
end
onInput("click", 5, false)
onInput("click", -1, false)
onInput("click", 9, true)
onInput("touch", 0, false)
print(table.concat(picks, ","), misses)

-- `continue` in a `repeat` goes to its condition
local function walk(list)
	local out, i, stack = {}, 0, list
	repeat
		i += 1
		local v = stack[i]
		if v == nil or v == false then
for _ = 1, 1 do
			continue
end
		end
		table.insert(out, v)
	until i >= #stack

end
